summary: An F4 time resolution of the tof Geant4 kit was labelled an estimate even when the study simulated no tail source; it is optimistic unless all four tail sources are simulated.

observables: the bound (estimate or optimistic) of F4 design-evaluations of the figure of merit time-resolution on a tof kit candidate
design verdicts and aggregations that combine those bounds
impact.bias: the tof kit's time is the truth crossing time plus one Gaussian smear, so its time resolution omits the scintillator, photodetector and electronics terms; labelled estimate, such a value could pass a requirement that an optimistic bound would leave undecided or fail
impact.trigger: an F4 design-evaluation of time-resolution whose study did not simulate all four tail sources (alignment, calibration-non-uniformity, noise-digitization, pattern-recognition)

remedy: rerun contracts/design.py (or evaluate_design.py f4 --replace) on the affected F4 time-resolution evaluations with a release that has the fix; an evaluation that recorded estimate without all four tail sources is then a design.contract_mismatch until it is redone with bound optimistic
